items.name: button
items.title: Sakuga Button
items.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-button>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Button is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/button.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-button>Confirm</sakuga-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: toggle
items.title: Sakuga Toggle
items.description: A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toggle>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-toggle label="Notifications"></sakuga-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: slider
items.title: Sakuga Slider
items.description: A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-slider>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-slider value="30" label="Volume"></sakuga-slider>, with min, max, step and unit. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Sakuga Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that slashes: crescents swing round the box, crystals fly, the tick draws itself, and ズザッ lands in dotted letters. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-checkbox>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Checkbox is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/checkbox.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-checkbox>Remember me</sakuga-checkbox>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: radio
items.title: Sakuga Radio
items.description: A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-radio>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Radio is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/radio.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option></sakuga-radio>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: input
items.title: Sakuga Input
items.description: A text field that kicks up a puff of dust from the caret on every key. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-input>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Input is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/input.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-input label="Name" placeholder="Type something"></sakuga-input>. Read and set el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: tabs
items.title: Sakuga Tabs
items.description: Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tabs>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Tabs is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/tabs.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-tabs label="Sections"><option>Home</option><option>Profile</option></sakuga-tabs>. Listen for change (e.detail: index, value, label) and show the panel yourself. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: progress
items.title: Sakuga Progress
items.description: A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-progress>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Progress is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/progress.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-progress label="Loading"></sakuga-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for sakuga:done (fires once). el.reset() for the next task. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: rating
items.title: Sakuga Rating
items.description: Five stars that pop in one after another, with wedges and a hollow ポン on the last; five gets a burst. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-rating>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Rating is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/rating.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-rating label="Rating"></sakuga-rating>. Read el.value (0 to 5) and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: toast
items.title: Sakuga Toast
items.description: A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toast>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Toast is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/toast.js with a script tag (not a module), then use Put <sakuga-toast></sakuga-toast> where toasts should appear and call el.show("Saved"). It stays for the duration attribute (2.6 s) or until el.hide(). More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Sakuga Tooltip
items.description: A help button whose hint springs out like a speech bubble, with puffs and a hollow カチッ. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tooltip>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sakuga Tooltip is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/tooltip.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-tooltip text="Helpful hint!"></sakuga-tooltip>. Opens on hover, focus and tap; Escape closes it. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

items.name: badge
items.title: Sakuga Badge
items.description: A two-tone manga status stamp, live status chip (with dot), and clickable filter pill with spring pop, wedges, and kira glint. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-badge>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/badge.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-badge tone="green" dot active>Online</sakuga-badge> or <sakuga-badge clickable tone="pri" count="12">Filter</sakuga-badge>.

items.name: card
items.title: Sakuga Card
items.description: A manga panel surface with thick ink outline, hard offset shadow, tactile lift, and impact()/pulse() beats. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-card>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/card.js with a script tag, then wrap content in <sakuga-card heading="Panel" interactive>...</sakuga-card>.

items.name: chart
items.title: Sakuga Chart
items.description: A cel-shaded vertical bar chart and horizontal distribution bar component with staggered spring waves, dust puffs, and callout bubbles. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-chart>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/chart.js with a script tag, use <sakuga-chart mode="vertical" tone="pri" unit="h"></sakuga-chart>, and assign el.items.

items.name: collapse
items.title: Sakuga Collapse
items.description: A spring-animated collapsible manga drawer / accordion that settles to overflow visible so child effects are never clipped. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-collapse>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/collapse.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-collapse label="Details">...</sakuga-collapse>. Listen for change.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Sakuga Dialog
items.description: An anime slam-in manga modal with squash-stretch springs, corner puffs, braking lines, hollow ポン (or danger burst + ドン). One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-dialog>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/dialog.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-dialog heading="Confirm">...</sakuga-dialog> and toggle el.open.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Sakuga Heatmap
items.description: A manga-framed monthly calendar heatmap with 4-level two-tone swatches, spring wave entrance, speech-bubble tooltips, and peak day effects. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-heatmap>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/heatmap.js with a script tag, use <sakuga-heatmap></sakuga-heatmap>, and assign el.days. Listen for select.

items.name: number
items.title: Sakuga Number
items.description: A tactile numeric stepper with minus/plus buttons, caret dust, vertical value pop, and min/max recoil shards. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-number>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/number.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-number value="2.5" min="0" max="10" step="0.5" unit="h"></sakuga-number>.

items.name: picker
items.title: Sakuga Picker
items.description: A unified Date, Month, and Time input with a spring-animated manga speech-bubble popover and hollow カチッ on selection. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-picker>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/picker.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-picker type="date" value="2026-04-15"></sakuga-picker>.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Sakuga Segmented
items.description: A compact inline sliding-capsule selector that stretches with velocity and lands with wedges, braking puff, and speed lines. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-segmented>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/segmented.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-segmented value="auto"><option value="auto">Auto</option>...</sakuga-segmented>.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Sakuga Spinner
items.description: A cel-shaded anime kinetic loader drawn on a canvas stepped on the shared SakugaFX clock. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-spinner>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/spinner.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-spinner size="md" label="Loading..."></sakuga-spinner>.

items.name: stat
items.title: Sakuga Stat
items.description: A manga KPI stat card that pops on spring physics on value updates or hit(), with a slanted delta stamp, corner ticks, and kira glint. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-stat>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/stat.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-stat label="Total" value="18.50 h" delta="+1.20h" tone="pri"></sakuga-stat>.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Sakuga Stepper
items.description: A 4-step manga workflow tracker in a 2x2 grid or row that pops and draws checkmarks with wedges and kira glint when steps complete. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-stepper>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/stepper.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-stepper layout="grid"><option data-state="done">Step 1</option>...</sakuga-stepper>.

items.name: table
items.title: Sakuga Table
items.description: A manga-framed scrollable data table container with an empty-state stamp and a snappy sweep() refresh beat. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-table>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/table.js with a script tag, then wrap a <table> inside <sakuga-table max-height="360px">...</sakuga-table>.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Sakuga Textarea
items.description: A multiline manga text area with caret dust puffs, Enter speed-line sweep, character counter pill, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sakuga:commit. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-textarea>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/textarea.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-textarea label="Notes" rows="4" maxlength="200"></sakuga-textarea>.

items.name: select
items.title: Sakuga Select
items.description: Tactile, searchable manga dropdown combobox with a spring-animated speech-bubble popover, velocity-stretched highlight capsule, hollow カチッ selection hit, and slash-to-clear beat. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-select>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/select.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-select searchable clearable label="Style"><option value="cel">Cel Shaded</option>...</sakuga-select>. Works in forms with a name.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Sakuga Drawer
items.description: Anime skid-in manga slide-over drawer (right, left, or bottom) with velocity-coupled smear, seam braking dust puffs, wobble marks, pink corner ticks, dotted ズザッ, and danger mode with caution stripe, back-layer burst, shards, and hollow ドン. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-drawer>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/drawer.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-drawer side="right" heading="Inspector">...</sakuga-drawer> and call el.show() / el.close().

items.name: menu
items.title: Sakuga Menu
items.description: Triggered manga action and context menu with a spring speech-bubble panel, cel-shaded sliding highlight, keyboard shortcuts, checkable items, dividers, and an anime slash for danger actions. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-menu>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/menu.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-menu label="Actions"><option value="edit" data-icon="edit" data-shortcut="⌘E">Edit</option>...</sakuga-menu>. Supports openAt(x, y) and fires select.

items.name: upload
items.title: Sakuga Upload
items.description: Manga-framed drag-and-drop file dropzone and animated file queue with drag-over wind anticipation, back-layer drop burst, cel-shaded extension chips, and anime slash-to-remove. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-upload>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/upload.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-upload multiple accept="image/*,.pdf" max-size="5MB"></sakuga-upload>. Works in forms with a name; fires change and sakuga:reject.

items.name: tags
items.title: Sakuga Tags
items.description: Interactive manga tag / chip input box where typing kicks up caret dust, adding stamps a cel-shaded chip with hollow ポン, deleting slices it with a pink crescent slash, and duplicates or max-limit hits play spring recoil. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tags>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/tags.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-tags value="sakuga,cel-shaded" max="6" suggestions="smear,impact"></sakuga-tags>. Works in forms with a name.

items.name: otp
items.title: Sakuga OTP
items.description: A manga verification-code and PIN input row with per-cell spring pops, rapid domino paste wave, completion starburst with ドン! (or hollow ポン for 4-digit PINs), and underdamped error recoil. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-otp>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/otp.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-otp length="6" separator="3" name="code"></sakuga-otp>. Listen for sakuga:complete; call el.fill(code) or el.error(msg).

items.name: pagination
items.title: Sakuga Pagination
items.description: Kinetic manga page switcher where the active ink-framed tile leaps across pages on spring physics, lands with braking dust and pink wedges, and unleashes a lavender crescent slash + シュッ on far jumps. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-pagination>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/pagination.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-pagination page="1" pages="12" show-edges></sakuga-pagination>. Listen for change (e.detail: page, prev, pages).

items.name: gauge
items.title: Sakuga Gauge
items.description: Cel-shaded anime radial arc gauge and mecha tachometer on a high-DPI shared-clock canvas with spring physics, slanted digital readout badge, interactive dial drag/keyboard control, and redline overdrive VFX. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-gauge>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Load /sakuga-vfx/gauge.js with a script tag, then use <sakuga-gauge value="25" label="Boost" unit="%" interactive></sakuga-gauge>. Call el.set(val) or el.rev(); listen for sakuga:overdrive.
